boundary: Authored workflow candidates derived from local skill owners; not research findings, clinical rules, compliance advice or approved operating policy. Replace actors, states, rights and metrics with project truth. No outcome uplift has been measured.

actors.decision: Describe installed system and required scope
Authorize documented scope within verified authority

critical_distinctions: Request received is not an accepted scope
Illustrative diagram is not an as-built drawing
Approval is not proof of commissioning or safe operation

failure_and_recovery.recovery: Keep unknown visible, retain request and assign clarification
Expose changed boundary and follow the actual reapproval path

metrics.name: Clarification loops
metrics.definition: Clarification returns per scoped request; inspect reasons
metrics.guardrail: Do not hide exclusions to reduce the count

metrics.name: Traceability coverage
metrics.definition: Accepted requirements with current acceptance evidence / accepted requirements
metrics.guardrail: A link does not prove the test passed

role_tasks.orientation: Find the capability matching the operating need.
role_tasks.offering: Inspect inputs, outputs, interfaces and exclusions before requesting work.
role_tasks.evidence: Follow a requirement through decision, artifact and verification status.
role_tasks.conversion: Submit a scoped inquiry with unknowns preserved and a truthful receipt.
role_tasks.catalog: Compare capabilities using consistent operating attributes and responsibility boundaries.
role_tasks.editorial: Read a usable explanation; distinguish concept from approved operating instruction.

validation_questions: Can the engineer identify what remains outside scope?
Can the service owner locate the current revision and next accountable person?

actors.decision: Compare attributes, select a real variant and review total
Supply availability, price and fulfillment constraints
Report actual authorization, order and delivery separately

critical_distinctions: A cart line does not reserve stock unless verified
Popularity, scarcity and delivery promises require real sources

failure_and_recovery.recovery: Preserve query, show filters and offer a clear reset
Retain other lines; offer eligible alternatives with changed price explicit
Show pending/reconciliation; avoid blind duplicate payment

metrics.name: Variant errors
metrics.guardrail: Do not remove meaningful options to improve the rate

metrics.name: Checkout completion
metrics.definition: Confirmed orders / eligible checkout starts in a declared window
metrics.guardrail: Track unexpected costs, duplicate orders and returns

role_tasks.orientation: Route by shopper need using actual product evidence.
role_tasks.catalog: Compare consistent attributes and preserve filter context on mobile.
role_tasks.offering: Resolve variant, fit/material, availability and actual cost.
role_tasks.conversion: Review cost, correct input and distinguish payment pending from confirmed order.
role_tasks.editorial: Explain selection/care with usable examples and sourced product constraints.

validation_questions: Can the shopper identify selected variant and total?
Can an empty filter recover without losing the query?

critical_distinctions: Team output is not individual contribution
Expert walkthrough is not participant research
Screenshots do not prove business uplift

failure_and_recovery.recovery: Explain redaction; show permitted reasoning without inventing results
Provide permitted readable summary and honest unavailable state

metrics.name: Evidence findability
metrics.definition: Observed ability to find role, contribution and decision artifact in a declared task
metrics.guardrail: Self-review does not measure recruiter success

metrics.name: Claim integrity
metrics.definition: Claims with supporting evidence or explicit limitation / material claims

role_tasks.orientation: Show target role, relevant work and a clear route into evidence.
role_tasks.evidence: Pair decision with actual artifact, contribution, constraints and unknowns.
role_tasks.conversion: Offer working contact/CV paths with consistent identity.
role_tasks.editorial: Explain a design trade-off without replacing evidence with process jargon.

validation_questions: Can a reviewer separate individual from team work?
Can they distinguish measured, inferred and planned outcomes?

actors.decision: Specify resource, role, reason and duration
Report actual execution and reconcile failures
Inspect scope, expiry and event evidence

critical_distinctions: Connector listing is not integration proof
Event history does not establish compliance certification

failure_and_recovery.recovery: Separate approval/execution; expose owner, reason and authorized retry
Show current scope/version; review material changes

metrics.name: Unresolved fulfillment age
metrics.definition: Time from approval to verified execution grouped by actual pending/failed reason
metrics.guardrail: Do not count approval as fulfillment

metrics.name: Revocation evidence coverage
metrics.definition: Revocations with verified execution / requested revocations
metrics.guardrail: Expiry alone does not satisfy the numerator

role_tasks.orientation: Find requests needing attention with owner and next action.
role_tasks.offering: Inspect resource, scope, duration and integration boundary.
role_tasks.evidence: Trace request, decision and execution as distinct events.
role_tasks.conversion: Review and submit scoped request with retained input and pending feedback.
role_tasks.catalog: Compare eligible software resources/roles without universal provisioning claims.
role_tasks.editorial: Explain permissions/review using actual project policy.

validation_questions: Can an operator distinguish approved-but-pending from active?
Can they identify the recovery owner?

actors.decision: Check selected person, request context and next practical action
Report current stored state and actual receipt only

critical_distinctions: Stock portrait is not assigned clinician
Saved draft is not submitted request
Completed appointment is not a clinical outcome

failure_and_recovery.recovery: Preserve patient/contact input; offer currently eligible choices
Retain entered values/selection; expose edit paths
Show last-known state, source time when known and verified contact; invent no response promise

metrics.name: Request completion
metrics.definition: Actual received requests / eligible starts in a declared window
metrics.guardrail: Do not label these confirmed visits

metrics.name: Recovery success
metrics.definition: Observed ability to correct input/slot error and continue the task
metrics.guardrail: Synthetic browser scenarios are not patient study results

role_tasks.app-overview: Identify selected patient, next actual appointment/request and contextual action.
role_tasks.app-selection: Compare eligible options and recover from empty filters.
role_tasks.app-task: Enter/review necessary details; back and validation retain input.
role_tasks.app-record: Read actual status, next accountable actor and verified action.
role_tasks.app-support: Find verified contact with context retained; do not generate clinical triage.

validation_questions: Can the patient distinguish pending from confirmed?
Can they correct details without losing person or slot?
